```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, tidy.opts=list(width.cutoff=80), tidy=TRUE) 
```

```{r calling packages, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(psych)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(rmarkdown)
```

```{r calling data, include=FALSE}
HSdata <- read_csv("HS_Data.csv")
HSdata_wide <- read_csv("HSdata_wide.csv")
```
These analyses reflect those reported in "Interleaved Retrieval Practice Promotes Science Learning" by Faria Sana and Veronica Yan.
See https://osf.io/aqng6/ for more details. 

# MAIN REGRESSION ANALYSES
## Practice Quiz Scores
```{r regression analyses: practice quiz, echo=FALSE}
PracticeScores <- lmer(PracticeScore ~ Schedule + (1|ID) + (1|CourseGrade/Concept), data=HSdata)
summary(PracticeScores)
```
## Final Test Scores
```{r regression analyses: final test,echo=FALSE}
FinalTest <- lmer(TestScore ~ Condition + (1|ID) + (1|CourseGrade/Concept), data=HSdata)
summary(FinalTest)

```
***
# DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS
## Overall
```{r descriptives overall}
psych::describe(HSdata_wide[7:13])
```
## By Classroom
```{r descriptives by classroom, echo=FALSE}
#Practice Quizzes#
bp_means <- aggregate(HSdata_wide$BlockedPractice, list(HSdata_wide$Classroom), mean)
bp_sds <- aggregate(HSdata_wide$BlockedPractice, list(HSdata_wide$Classroom), sd)
ip_means <- aggregate(HSdata_wide$InterleavedPractice, list(HSdata_wide$Classroom), mean)
ip_sds <- aggregate(HSdata_wide$InterleavedPractice, list(HSdata_wide$Classroom), sd)
practice <- data.frame(bp_means, bp_sds[2], ip_means[2], ip_sds[2])
colnames(practice) <- c('Classroom', 'Blocked Practice Mean', 'Blocked Practice SD', 
                        'Interleaved Practice Mean', 'Interleaved Practice SD')

round(practice,2)

#Final Test
cf_means <- aggregate(HSdata_wide$ControlTestScore, list(HSdata_wide$Classroom), mean)
cf_sd <- aggregate(HSdata_wide$ControlTestScore, list(HSdata_wide$Classroom), sd)
bf_means <- aggregate(HSdata_wide$BlockedTestScore, list(HSdata_wide$Classroom), mean)
bf_sds <- aggregate(HSdata_wide$BlockedTestScore, list(HSdata_wide$Classroom), sd)
if_means <- aggregate(HSdata_wide$InterleavedTestScore, list(HSdata_wide$Classroom), mean)
if_sds <- aggregate(HSdata_wide$InterleavedTestScore, list(HSdata_wide$Classroom), sd)
final <- data.frame(cf_means, cf_sd[2], bf_means[2], bf_sds[2], if_means[2], if_sds[2])
colnames(final) <- c('Classroom', 'Control Final Mean', 'Control Final SD', 
                     'Blocked Final Mean', 'Blocked Final SD', 
                     'Interleaved Final Mean', 'Interleaved Final SD')

round(final,2)
```
# Cohen's d Effect Sizes
```{r effect sizes}
BlockedPracticeMean <- mean(HSdata_wide$BlockedPractice)
InterleavedPracticeMean <- mean(HSdata_wide$InterleavedPractice)
BlockedPracticeSD <- sd(HSdata_wide$BlockedPractice)
InterleavedPracticeSD <- sd(HSdata_wide$InterleavedPractice)
ControlFinalMean <- mean(HSdata_wide$ControlTestScore)
BlockedFinalMean <- mean(HSdata_wide$BlockedTestScore)
InterleavedFinalMean <- mean(HSdata_wide$InterleavedTestScore)
ControlFinalSD <- sd(HSdata_wide$ControlTestScore)
BlockedFinalSD <- sd(HSdata_wide$BlockedTestScore)
InterleavedFinalSD <- sd(HSdata_wide$InterleavedTestScore)

Practice_d <- (BlockedPracticeMean-InterleavedPracticeMean)/
                          ((BlockedPracticeSD + InterleavedPracticeSD)/2) 
Final_ControlBlock_d <- (ControlFinalMean-BlockedFinalMean)/((ControlFinalSD+BlockedFinalSD)/2) 
Final_BlockInt_d <- (InterleavedFinalMean-BlockedFinalMean)/((InterleavedFinalSD+BlockedFinalSD)/2)
Final_ControlInt_d <- (InterleavedFinalMean-ControlFinalMean)/((InterleavedFinalSD+ControlFinalSD)/2)

effectsizes <- data.frame(Practice_d, Final_ControlBlock_d, Final_BlockInt_d, Final_ControlInt_d)
colnames(effectsizes) <- c('Quizzes: Blk-Int', 'Final: Ctrl-Blk', 'Final: Int-Blk', 'Final: Int-Ctrl')
rownames(effectsizes) <- c('Cohens d')

effectsizes

```

# EXPLORATORY ANALYSES
## Is the Interleaving Benefit on Final Test Related to the Int-Block Difference on Practice Test?
```{r exploratory analyses 1}

HSdata$zIntBlock_PracticeDiff <- as.numeric(scale(HSdata$IntBlock_PracticeDiff))
FinalTest_PracticeMod <- lmer(TestScore ~ Condition*zIntBlock_PracticeDiff + 
                                (1|ID) + (1|CourseGrade/Concept), data=HSdata)
summary(FinalTest_PracticeMod)
```

## Counter-balanced Classes Only (i.e., Grade 9 Science, Grade 11 Biology)
```{r exploratory analyses 2}
HSdata_widepaired <- HSdata_wide[which(HSdata_wide$CourseGrade=="Biology11" | 
                                  HSdata_wide$CourseGrade=="Science9"),]

psych::describe(HSdata_widepaired[11:12])

#cohen's d
(mean(HSdata_widepaired$InterleavedTestScore)-mean(HSdata_widepaired$BlockedTestScore))/
  mean(sd(HSdata_widepaired$InterleavedTestScore), sd(HSdata_widepaired$BlockedTestScore))

```
